name: prometheus.enrich

arguments.name: forward_to
arguments.description: Where to forward metrics after enrichment.

arguments.name: targets
arguments.description: List of targets from a discovery component.

arguments.name: labels_to_copy
arguments.description: List of labels to copy from discovered targets to metrics. If empty, the component copies all labels.

arguments.name: metrics_match_label
arguments.description: (Deprecated) The label from incoming metrics to match against discovered targets, for example "service_name".

arguments.name: target_match_label
arguments.description: (Deprecated) The label from discovered targets to match against, for example, "__inventory_consul_service".

arguments.name: target_to_metric_match
arguments.description: Map of target label name to metric label name. All entries must match for enrichment.

exported_fields.name: receiver
exported_fields.description: The input receiver where the component receives samples to enrich.
